name: The Princess's Surprise
label: Quest
description: The Princess's Surprise: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thaurissan was a great and honorable dwarf. You ruined my life and the life of my unborn child!
You think that Princess Bronzebeard may still be suffering from the residual effect of the Emperor's spell.
Return to Ironforge and tell my father that the heir to the Kingdom of Ironforge will be a Dark Iron dwarf.
Whether he approves or not, it shall be.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It seems that even in death, Thaurissan has won.
You are dismissed, friend. Before you leave, you may choose your reward from the royal vault.
King Bronzebeard slumps into his throne to mull over this bizarre change of events.
